title: Conversion options
description: Validated controls accepted by multipart options and the SDK.

sections.title: Route-specific behavior
paragraphs: Options apply only to relevant engines. A PDF job produces the selected page rather than an archive of all pages. Output paths, executable names, and arbitrary engine flags are rejected.

sections.title: Apply controls to the right job
paragraphs: quality and image dimensions apply to suitable image or media routes. page and dpi control PDF rendering; start, duration, fps, and mute apply to appropriate media conversions. Supplying a valid option does not make every engine use it.
Numbers must be JSON numbers, not strings. Unknown keys, arrays instead of objects, and invalid ranges return HTTP 400 before a job is accepted.
